name: cactus-compute/needle
title: cactus-compute/needle
headline: Tool-calling model small enough for microcontrollers
lede: You can run tool calls, structured extraction and embeddings from a 2-bit model of 8 to 29 MB on phones, wearables, robots and microcontrollers.

effects.effect: Automation without a network round trip
Embeddings can be computed on the device itself
On-device tool use becomes plausible for small robots
